newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dadonghai '96 net jumps 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dadonghai '96 net jumps 50 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.185 yuan vs 0.17 yuan
Net assets per share 1.40 yuan vs 1.23 yuan
Company name: Hainan Dadonghai Tourism Centre (Holdings) Co Ltd.

NOTE: The results were calculated under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which were based on international standards. They were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, the company posted net profits of 59.22 million yuan in 1996 against 40.85 million yuan in 1995, the report said.
The company's board of directors have proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on June 8, it said.
Trading in Dadonghai's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning for the annual results announcement and resumed in the afternoon.
